sampling: Paired iid uniform draws inside declared parameter ranges. Not experimental confidence intervals. No aggregate score across conflicting objectives.
scope_note: Twenty-two selected parameters include finite liquid relaxation time and activation energy, retention scale and liquid mobility. Gas permeability, initial pore radius, water reverse factor and evaporation A/E remain fixed, as do liquid latent contrast and transition width. Eight paired samples do not establish all-parameter, glass-yield, condensation-kinetic-range or permeability-range robustness. Adding sampled dimensions changes the draws for other parameters; differences from older ensembles cannot be solely assigned to the new phase mechanism.
